'''Wedge Antilles' X-wing''' was a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] piloted by [[Captain]] [[Wedge Antilles]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="ANH" /> and the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
